title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Title Update v1.1.0
summary: Find out the latest EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Update details in the Title Update v1.1.0 Notes.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: EA SPORTS FC 27 version 1.1.0 is now live and includes the updates below. There are no gameplay balance and tuning changes in this update.

sections.title: Gameplay
sections.summary: Addressed the following issues: In some cases, players could become stuck during the game opening tutorial. [PC Only] If using a mouse and keyboard and playing as a Goal Keeper, the mouse could become unresponsive if moved too far outside of the penalty box.

sections.title: Ultimate Team
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Streamlined SBCs filters will save previously applied filters when completing multiple Streamlined SBCs in the same session. Reduced the duration of the pack opening sequence.

sections.title: The Grounds
sections.summary: Addressed the following issues: Addressed instances of matches partially resetting after a player joins an ongoing match after initially failing to Hot Join. Expired Live Events could be seen in the View Live Events and Rush Stadium Menus. [PC ONLY] Key…

sections.title: Career Mode
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Two new objective types have been added to Player Career Rivalries. Consistency Rivalries: Avoid being the first to fail an Objective.

sections.title: General, Audio, and Visual
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Added a Claim All button in the objective screens. Updated some kits, text, cinematics, cameras, audio, commentary, placeholder images, artwork, hair, overlays, trophies, TIFOs, starheads, particles, stadiums, lighting, ad boards,…

hits.label: Archetypes
hits.quote: When reaching the maximum Archetype Level, the Archetype Level would display incorrectly.

hits.label: PlayStyles
hits.quote: After selecting a PlayStyle players would be brought to the Attributes tab instead of staying in the PlayStyle tab.

hits.label: Amps
hits.quote: In some cases, players could become stuck in the FC Hub after purchasing an Amp from the Clubs Store.

hits.label: Rush
hits.quote: Expired Live Events could be seen in the View Live Events and Rush Stadium Menus. [PC ONLY] Key bindings could not be modified when playing on Keyboard Only.
